reason: I've never heard of Northline and $38 for a tee is more than I usually pay when I wait for a sale. 15% off a first order isn't enough of a deal to make me risk it on a brand I can't check out.
objection: How do I know the quality is really better? Every brand says quality fabric at fair prices, and I can't feel it or read real reviews, so I'd be paying $38 on faith.
would_change_my_mind: Lots of real reviews with photos from actual customers, plus free returns. Or a bigger first-order deal, like 30% off or a tee under $25, so I'm not risking much to test it.
